# Information security

## Identity and access

The public review presentation requires no password or GitHub account ([README.md:3-5](../README.md#L3-L5)). The repository contains no Entra ID or Okta registrations, MSAL flows, app roles, scopes, managed identities, or sign-in flow. No user identity is collected by application code.

## Data and secrets

The app displays static artwork and project metadata included in the repository, plus the visitor's current slide position. The position is kept in browser `sessionStorage` and the URL hash; it is not sent to an application backend ([deck/src/presentation.js:192-212](../deck/src/presentation.js#L192-L212)). No database, Key Vault, secret-backed app setting, or credential is present. The issue's resolved configuration input is empty; no client or tenant IDs, Key Vault name, allowed origins, or redirect URIs can be resolved.

## Trust boundaries and exposure

The public site is exposed to unauthenticated visitors at the documented review URL. The shell's Content Security Policy defaults to deny and restricts scripts, frames, network connections, workers, and images to same-origin sources (with `data:` permitted for images) ([index.html:2](../index.html#L2)). The deck and shell validate same-origin messaging before handling navigation events ([public.js:47-56](../public.js#L47-L56), [deck/src/presentation.js:208-223](../deck/src/presentation.js#L208-L223)).

The service worker exists to transition old routes; it unregisters and deliberately has no fetch listener, cache, encryption, or persistent storage ([sw.js:7-21](../sw.js#L7-L21)). External project and reference links lead to public sites; when followed, the visitor's browser leaves the repository's origin. The application does not make authenticated calls to these sites.

No Azure network boundary, private endpoint, firewall policy, or allowlist is defined in this repository.
